section: India - cotton textiles, jute, sugar, cement, paper, fertiliser and petrochemical industries
subsections: FIRST modern industrial units → place and year

accepted.s: Who was associated with the establishment of the first successful cotton mill in India at Mumbai in 1854?
accepted.x: C.N. Davar was associated with the first successful cotton mill established at Mumbai in 1854.
accepted.tq: Directly link the industrial milestone with the person associated with it.
accepted.sec: FIRST modern industrial units → place and year  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The first jute mill was established at Rishra near Kolkata in 1855. The other pairs contain incorrect years.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure place-year pair and eliminate the altered dates.
accepted.sec: FIRST modern industrial units → place and year  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the early iron and steel industry in India:
1. Iron works on modern lines were established at Porto Novo in 1830.
2. Bengal Iron Works was established in 1870.
3. TISCO at Jamshedpur was established in 1907.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Porto Novo, Bengal Iron Works and TISCO are associated with 1830, 1870 and 1907 respectively.
accepted.tq: Check each industrial milestone independently before selecting the combined code.
accepted.sec: FIRST modern industrial units → place and year  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The first cement plant in India, established in 1904 and using sea shells as lime, was located at
accepted.x: The first cement plant was established at Madras, now Chennai, in 1904; it subsequently failed.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive raw-material clue to identify the first cement plant and its location.
accepted.sec: FIRST modern industrial units → place and year  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The first successful cement factory in India was established at Porbandar by the
accepted.x: The first successful cement factory was established at Porbandar by the Indian Cement Company in 1912–13.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the first unsuccessful plant from the first successful plant by place, organisation and period.

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Coimbatore is known as the Manchester of South India. Jamshedpur is called the Pittsburgh of India, while Ahmedabad is the Manchester of India.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped nickname-city pair among otherwise familiar associations.

accepted.s: Ahmedabad is popularly known as the
accepted.x: Ahmedabad is popularly known as the Manchester of India.
accepted.tq: Directly test the city associated with a well-known industrial nickname.

accepted.s:
With reference to recent sugar-sector measures, consider the following statements:
1. India permitted duty-free import of up to 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar.
2. The measure was described as the first such import in nearly a decade.
3. The Fair and Remunerative Price was raised by ₹10 per quintal for 2026–27.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The measure concerned duty-free imports of up to 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar, and FRP was raised by ₹10 per quintal for 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Separate the quantity, time comparison and price revision before choosing the coded option.

accepted.s: The Perform, Achieve and Trade scheme is moving towards the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme for how many sectors, including cement, fertilisers, paper, textiles and petrochemicals?
accepted.x: The transition involves nine sectors, including cement, fertilisers, paper, textiles, petrochemicals and refining.
accepted.tq: Test the exact sector count rather than the list of examples alone.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs correctly represents two recent developments related to Indian industries?
o: Raw-jute surplus in West Bengal mills and customs duty on 40 petrochemical products doubled
Raw-jute scarcity in Andhra Pradesh mills and customs duty waiver on 40 cement products
Raw-jute scarcity in West Bengal mills and customs duty waiver on 40 petrochemical products
Raw-jute imports stopped and customs duty waived on all petrochemical products
accepted.x: A raw-jute scarcity crisis affected West Bengal mills, while customs duty was waived on 40 petrochemical products amid higher input prices caused by the war.
accepted.tq: Compare the location, commodity and scale of the two reported policy developments.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding jute and paper industries in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: Andhra Pradesh has no jute mills but is a major paper-producing state at Nellimarla.
Jute mills at Chittivalasa and Nellimarla were established after 2000, and paper production is associated with Visakhapatnam.
Jute mills at Chittivalasa and Nellimarla have existed since the 1920s, and paper production is associated with Rajahmundry.
Rajahmundry is associated with jute mills, while Chittivalasa is associated only with cement.
accepted.x: Chittivalasa and Nellimarla have had jute mills since the 1920s, and Rajahmundry is associated with the paper industry.
accepted.tq: Use the place-and-industry association to eliminate reversed locations and dates.

accepted.s:
Which of the following sequences represents the correct chronological order of the first major units listed below?
A. First successful cotton mill at Mumbai
B. First jute mill at Rishra
C. First cement plant at Madras
D. First woollen mill at Kanpur
accepted.x: The correct order is Mumbai cotton mill (1854), Rishra jute mill (1855), Kanpur woollen mill (1876), and Madras cement plant (1904).
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the two middle dates.

accepted.s:
With reference to the new Index of Core Industries, consider the following statements:
1. Its base year is 2022–23.
2. Iron ore was added, taking the number of industries to nine.
3. Electricity has the highest weight of 30.932 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The revised index uses 2022–23 as the base year, adds iron ore among nine industries, and assigns electricity a 30.932% weight.
accepted.tq: Verify the base year, composition and highest-weight figure separately.

accepted.s: India became a net steel importer during which period of 2025–26, according to the Economic Survey 2025–26?
accepted.x: India became a net steel importer during April–October of 2025–26. It continued to depend on imported coking coal.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact reporting period from nearby alternative time ranges.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about India’s steel sector:
1. India remains dependent on imported coking coal.
2. Approximately 93% of planned ironmaking capacity is coal-based.
3. The Green Steel Taxonomy was introduced in 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. India depends on imported coking coal, about 93% of planned ironmaking capacity is coal-based, and the Green Steel Taxonomy dates from 2024.
accepted.tq: Combine the dependency, percentage and policy-year facts without reversing their scope.

accepted.s: Which one of the following groups consists only of sectors covered by the Green Steel Taxonomy and the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme as indicated for the industrial transition?
o: Steel, jute, sugar and cotton textiles
Aluminium, jute, paper and petroleum retail
accepted.x: The identified group is steel, cement, fertiliser and aluminium. These sectors are covered in the stated context of green steel and carbon-credit transition measures.
accepted.tq: Identify the option containing only sectors belonging to the specified policy group.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the industrial facilities located at Visakhapatnam?
o: RINL steel, Hindustan Shipyard and HPCL refinery
TISCO steel, Garden Reach Shipbuilders and IOC refinery
BHEL steel, Hindustan Aeronautics and BPCL refinery
SAIL steel, Cochin Shipyard and HPCL refinery
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is associated with RINL steel, Hindustan Shipyard and the HPCL refinery.
accepted.tq: Match the city with its cluster of steel, shipbuilding and refinery facilities.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding jute mills in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: Andhra Pradesh has 12 jute mills and ranks first in the number of jute mills among the states.
Andhra Pradesh has 20 jute mills and ranks second in cement capacity.
Andhra Pradesh has 12 jute mills and ranks second in the number of jute mills among the states.
Andhra Pradesh has no jute mills but ranks first in jute exports.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has 12 jute mills and is described as having the second-highest number of jute mills. It also leads in cement capacity.
accepted.tq: Separate the numerical count from the rank and avoid reversing the comparative claim.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly describes Andhra Pradesh’s position in the cement industry?
o: Its cement capacity is lower than its paper capacity by definition.
It has no major cement capacity but leads in jute mills.
It has the second-highest cement capacity after every other southern state.
It leads in cement capacity among the states mentioned in the industrial comparison.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is noted for leading cement capacity. The other statements either reverse or distort this position.
accepted.tq: Test the state-level comparative position without confusing cement capacity with jute-mill count.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): Electricity has the highest weight in the revised Index of Core Industries.
Reason (R): Electricity carries a weight of 30.932 per cent in that index.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the specified weight of 30.932% explains why electricity has the highest weight in the index.
accepted.tq: Check whether the numerical reason directly establishes the comparative assertion.
